'''Linh''' was a [[Gender|female]] [[human]] [[Jedi Initiate]] who was part of the [[Jedi Order]] during the [[High Republic Era]].<ref name="Uprooted" /> She was part of a group of new Jedi younglings including [[Bren]] and [[Zotti]] who were brought to the [[Tenoo Jedi Temple]] from the [[Coruscant]] [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="AJOAP" /> Later, she accompanied fellow Jedi younglings [[Kai Brightstar]] and [[Nubs]] on a mission to rescue the rare [[barelia flower]] from the elderly woman [[Prue Canti]].<ref name="Uprooted" /> Linh was later present when the [[Spider-King]] went lose in the Tenoo Jedi Temple.<ref name="Sticky">{{YJA|A Sticky Situation}}</ref>
